title: When the Postcard Falls
author: Mirabel Delacroix
blurb: Astrid Sandoval, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
